title: BIR Forms
description: Prepare, check and queue a taxpayer's BIR returns: pick a form and period, fill it, validate it with the official rules, save the draft, and queue it for filing.

title: BIR Tax Profile
description: View and edit a taxpayer's registration: name, TIN and branches, RDO and address, and the forms they file each year.

title: BIR Calendar
description: See when each taxpayer's BIR returns are due and where each one stands, month by month, and move a deadline (or put it back) for every taxpayer.

title: BIR Deadlines
description: The next BIR returns due for one taxpayer (or all of them), as a small card in the chat, each with a button that opens it in BIR Forms.

title: BIR answer: taxpayers
description: Answer cards about taxpayers: which one you mean, one taxpayer at a glance, their branches, adding a new one, how every taxpayer stands and who files on time.

title: BIR answer: returns
description: Answer cards about returns: a taxpayer's forms, the year at a glance, one return's progress, what blocks it, what a form is, unfinished drafts, the sending queue and one form across every taxpayer.

title: BIR answer: deadlines
description: Answer cards about deadlines: what's due next, this week, a month, late returns and a penalty estimate.

title: BIR answer: payments
description: Answer cards about payments: returns not paid, what was paid this year, and what the routines recorded overnight.

title: BIR answer: help
description: Answer cards about BIR itself: whether sign-in, the database and the sending queue are working.

title: BIR answer: one return
description: Answer cards about one return: its computation, a paper view of the filled form, what an amendment changes, its attachments, and filling it from a spreadsheet.

title: BIR answer: quick actions
description: Short answer cards with one decision: allow a send, a payment found in mail, marking a return paid, BIR's confirmation, signing in, a moved deadline and reminders.

title: BIR answer: lookups
description: Answer cards for quick lookups: an ATC, an RDO, and a tax on an amount.

title: Buwiz Sign-in
description: Sign in to Buwiz (or create an account) on this computer so BIR can open the taxpayer database.
